runtime.charge_timing: Durably replace and fsync the shared budget before every subprocess dispatch; a dispatched failure remains charged.
runtime.concurrency_rule: No other Moon budget writer may run concurrently with this authorized diagnostic.

memory_and_claim_ceiling.claim_ceiling: Mechanism-local attribution and non-causal hindsight upper bounds only; no input-class, ratio, corpus-quality, realizable-gain, candidate, SOTA, championship, product, or funding claim.

authority.exact_owner_literal_template: Authorize Moon C1 residual diagnostic at readiness commit {FINAL_READINESS_COMMIT}
authority.binding_rule: Replace the placeholder with the full 40-hex final readiness commit. At that exact commit, the literal authorizes exactly the two listed retained-snapshot reads, the durable local attempt ref, two shared Moon budget charges from 52 to 54, and only the two listed diagnostic reports, sweep-summary.json, and SHA256SUMS; any other spelling, commit, tree, source hash, snapshot identity, item index, SSE width, command, budget, or output roster refuses.

accepted_limitations: Acc size wording tension: aggregation_struct_bytes uses Rust size_of::<Acc>() as a logical accounting component while the report simultaneously excludes stack, allocator overhead, and Vec capacity; it is a conservative bookkeeping proxy, not a direct allocation or RSS measurement.

Post-link cleanup ambiguity: held-directory no-force publication hard-links a validated, synced private pending inode containing the retained in-memory bytes to the destination; if later pending-link cleanup fails, the destination may already be validly published while the command reports failure and leaves the pending hard link.

Shadow collision-test evidence limitation: tests pin low-width slot rotation, deterministic fifth-candidate eviction, and depth monotonicity through factored helpers, but do not construct a full production-width end-to-end hash-collision corpus.
Shadow rows are non-causal per-position candidate-diversity upper bounds; candidates may change every byte, so the rows are prohibited as direct funding evidence and as realizable-gain evidence.

procedure.rehearsal: Lifecycle tests use temporary synthetic snapshots and a fake kernel to prove authorization, duplicate-key refusal at every inbound JSON nesting depth, preflight, durable pre-dispatch charge, dispatch-failure, and held-directory publication behavior. A separate explicitly gated owner-host Python integration test materializes e514b23 and performs two independent clean build invocations through the same exact fixed exclusive production build root, requires byte-identical frozen release SHA-256, runs that real producer on the pinned synthetic source, matches the complete report/event/tape goldens, and passes those actual bytes through the Python validator. Foreign-host CI skips exactly those two pinned-host tests; the readiness command requires 34 tests with zero skips. The fake-kernel layer is not claimed as producer parity.
